data: Is the green line always higher than the orange line?

The green line represents the WMT17 EN-DE Transformer with Aux EOS loss, while the orange line represents the WMT17 EN-DE Transformer without Aux EOS loss. The caption states that the model trained with the auxiliary EOS loss can predict longer sentences compared with the original model. This implies that the green line is generally higher than the orange line across all k-step look-ahead values. However, there is a point where the orange line intersects with or becomes higher than the green line, specifically at k-step look-ahead value 5. Therefore, the green line is not always higher than the orange line.
